grh_473c4fd5fe0b1517a37c.title: Mr Blandings Builds His Dream House
paragraphs: Advertising executive Jim Blandings is tired of cramped New York apartment life and decides that moving his family to the country will solve everything. Instead, the supposedly simple dream house becomes an escalating chain of surveys, architects, contractors, wells, unexpected construction costs, and new emergencies that push the project far beyond its original budget. grh_476d3194cf8eeebf70fd.title: Long Ago
